title: GINIO: A Geometric SO(3)-Equivariant Interface for Neural Inertial Odometry
abstract: arXiv:2609.25338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural inertial odometry increasingly uses networks as learned measurements inside filtering pipelines. Such measurements should transform consistently under arbitrary IMU mounting conventions: their mean must transform as a vector, and their covariance must transform congruently as a second-order tensor. We present GINIO, a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry under arbitrary rotations of the IMU measurement frame. Given calibrated IMU windows, our framework predicts a motion measurement and uncertainty obeying these tensorial laws. To support efficient sensor-frame learning, we introduce Last-Frame Alignment (LFA), a deterministic preprocessing step that is provably equivalent to world-frame training for SO(3)-equivariant predictors. translated_title: GINIO：一种用于神经惯性里程计的几何SO(3)等变接口
translated_abstract: 神经惯性里程计越来越多地在滤波管线中将网络用作学习到的测量。这类测量应在任意IMU安装约定下保持一致的变换：其均值必须作为向量进行变换，其协方差必须作为二阶张量进行合同变换。我们提出了GINIO，一种在IMU测量坐标系任意旋转下适用于神经惯性里程计的几何SO(3)等变接口。给定校准后的IMU窗口，我们的框架预测服从这些张量定律的运动测量及其不确定性。为了支持高效的传感器坐标系学习，我们引入了末帧对齐，这是一种确定性的预处理步骤，对于SO(3)等变预测器而言，可证明其与世界坐标系训练等价。所连接的估计器跟踪传感器局部状态（如IMU偏差），将干扰估计与学习测量所强制的几何定律分离开来。我们实例化……
tldr: 提出了GINIO，一个几何SO(3)等变接口，使神经惯性里程计的学习测量在任意IMU坐标系旋转下遵循正确的向量与二阶张量变换规律，并引入可证明与世界坐标系训练等价的末帧对齐（LFA）预处理方法，实现高效的传感器坐标系学习。
en_tdlr: GINIO presents a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry that ensures learned measurements transform correctly as vectors and second-order tensors under arbitrary IMU frame rotations, with a provably equivalent Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) preprocessing enabling efficient sensor-frame learning.
